title: Engine idle, start and stall behavior
inputs: Document engine assembly, fuel, electrical, temperature and choke states
Capture cold start, warm start, stable warm idle and controlled load-to-stall
Synchronize visible tachometer/video markers with input timing
expected: Idle RPM band, warm-up behavior and stability
Stall RPM or condition with gear, clutch and load context
toleranceNotes: At least five valid trials per state. Report median, minimum and maximum; no exact RPM claim from dashboard pixels without declared reading uncertainty.
